groups.name: iqkv.db
groups.description: Intermediary database connection properties. Values are composed into spring.datasource by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.rabbitmq
groups.description: Intermediary RabbitMQ connection properties. Values are composed into spring.rabbitmq by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq
groups.description: RabbitMQ messaging toggles. 'enabled' drives @ConditionalOnProperty in RabbitMQConfig and TenantProvisioningConsumer.

groups.name: iqkv.platform
groups.description: Platform-wide operational settings. Must be consistent across all core services (IAM, Billing, CMS, etc.) — all read the same ROLLOUT_MODE env var.

groups.name: iqkv.tenancy
groups.description: Tenancy settings shared by the platform. This service declares them in application.yml for consistency but has no local binding class; tenant routing is handled by the foundation-tenancy library.

groups.name: iqkv.liquibase
groups.description: Tenant-aware Liquibase migration configuration consumed by the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner.

groups.name: iqkv.billing
groups.description: Billing service integration consumed by the foundation-entitlement-plan-resolver-mvc PlanResolver for quota / plan enforcement.

groups.name: iqkv.ai
groups.description: AI chat prompt framing and token budgets applied to every chat request.

groups.name: iqkv.auth.jwt
groups.description: JWT token verification settings. Exactly one of jwks-uri or public-key-path must be set.

properties.name: iqkv.db.host
properties.description: Database server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.db.port
properties.description: Database server port.

properties.name: iqkv.db.name
properties.description: Database name.

properties.name: iqkv.db.username
properties.description: Database username.

properties.name: iqkv.db.password
properties.description: Database password.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker AMQP port.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.username
properties.description: RabbitMQ username.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: RabbitMQ password.

properties.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq.enabled
properties.description: Enables RabbitMQ messaging. When false, RabbitMQConfig and TenantProvisioningConsumer are skipped. Defaults to false for local safety; the Helm chart configmap sets MESSAGING_ENABLED per environment (sit/uat/prd).

properties.name: iqkv.platform.rollout-mode
properties.description: Platform-wide operational mode. Must match across all core services. MULTI_TENANT: each signup creates a new tenant. SINGLE_TENANT: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-key
properties.description: NanoID key of the default tenant used in SINGLE_TENANT mode. Format: 8 characters using alphabet [a-z0-9].

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-name
properties.description: Display name for the default tenant in SINGLE_TENANT mode.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.schema-prefix
properties.description: PostgreSQL schema name prefix for tenant schemas.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-schema
properties.description: Default (system) schema name.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.provisioning-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for tenant schema provisioning.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-runner-enabled
properties.description: Registers the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner so pending changesets are applied to every tenant schema on startup.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the system (public schema) Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the per-tenant schema Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.contexts
properties.description: Active Liquibase contexts. Set to 'demo' on non-production profiles to apply demo seed changelogs; omit for schema-only.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.bootstrap-tenants
properties.description: Tenant keys whose schemas are migrated during bootstrap, in addition to the system schema.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.upgrade-existing-tenants
properties.description: Whether the TenantLiquibaseRunner scans and upgrades already-provisioned tenant schemas on startup.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the billing service used for quota / plan enforcement. Consumed by the entitlement PlanResolver and by PlatformContextService.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.plan-refresh-interval
properties.description: How often the entitlement plan catalog cache is refreshed from the billing service.

properties.name: iqkv.ai.system-prompt
properties.description: System prompt injected on every chat request. Frames the assistant's role, constrains allowed topics and sets output style. Override via AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT without a rebuild.

properties.name: iqkv.ai.max-input-chars
properties.description: Maximum number of characters accepted from the user message (input guard). Longer messages are truncated before being sent to the LLM.

properties.name: iqkv.ai.max-output-tokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens the LLM may generate in a single response (output guard). Maps to ChatOptions.maxTokens().

properties.name: iqkv.ai.temperature
properties.description: Response creativity: 0.0-0.3 focused/factual, 0.7-1.0 creative.

properties.name: iqkv.ai.default-model
properties.description: Ollama model tag used when the client request omits the model field. Reads the same env var (SPRING_AI_OLLAMA_CHAT_OPTIONS_MODEL) as spring.ai.ollama.chat.model.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.jwks-uri
properties.description: JWKS URI of the IAM service. Preferred in deployed (K8s) environments; keys are fetched, cached and refreshed automatically on rotation. Mutually exclusive with public-key-path. Example: http://foundation-iam-service/.well-known/jwks.json

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.public-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA public key PEM file used for verifying JWTs. Supports classpath: and file: prefixes. Used for local development and tests; ignored when jwks-uri is set.

values.description: Multi-tenant mode: each signup creates a new tenant.
Single-tenant mode: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant.
Enable RabbitMQ — used by local, sit, uat and prd profiles.
Blank — fall back to iqkv.auth.jwt.public-key-path (local dev / tests).
